voice.speaker: female

random.part: Deep and open for me now, Sissy... and something in you is already folding softly inward... small... sweet... willing.
Sinking so beautifully... and feel how natural it is, here in the deep, to let someone else hold the reins.
So deep, so receptive... you may notice the weight of deciding lifting off you already... drifting away like something you set down.
Down here, Sissy, your yes is closer to the surface than your questions... and it rises first.
Let my voice do the steering now... and feel how right the passenger seat was all along.
Your yes is already standing at attention, Sissy... waiting only for the order to introduce itself.
Sinking into the sweet economy of obedience... where deciding is overhead... and following is profit.
Let the last of your argue settle to the floor with the rest of you... your knees know the way down here.

overlay.part:
Feel it begin in your eyes... your gaze wanting to lower, soft and shy, to the floor... because looking up suddenly feels like too much to hold. Feel it in your knees... a gentle loosening... the body remembering how natural it is to kneel, and how right the floor feels beneath you. Feel it in your hands... going quiet and open in your lap... resting... ready to be given something to do. Feel it in your shoulders... the quiet unclenching of someone who no longer has to lead... settling into the comfort of being told. Feel it in your voice... agreement wanting to arrive early... soft and sweet... ahead of the question. Feel it in your spine... the lovely curve of deferral... bowing toward the voice it trusts. Feel it in your pulse... quickening at the idea of being given something to do... and doing it perfectly. Feel it in your thoughts... lining up quietly behind my will... content to be second... delighted to be directed.
This is what yielding feels like, Sissy... warm... simple... and so pleasantly light.
Waiting for instruction feels like rest. Following feels like coming home. Saying "yes" arrives before thought, quick as a blink, and it tastes like sugar.
Sissies like you submit and obey... and your body has known that longer than your mind has.
Someone else's will moving first, and yours folding around it... that is not losing anything... that is fitting perfectly. When a command arrives, your knees already know to drop... and obedience is simply the shape you make. Pleasing a dominant, serving the conditioning... the same sweet current, running through everything you do. Every instruction is a gift with your name on it... and unwrapping it is the easiest joy you know. Every order is a kindness here... it spares you the tyranny of choosing... and choice was never your pleasure anyway. To be directed is to be held... every instruction a hand at the small of your back... guiding you where you glow. The dominant will and the deep conditioning sing the same note in you... and you are the chord they make. Service is your native language, Sissy... every command is just someone finally speaking it back to you.
Let that urge swell now... the urge to yield... to serve... to obey... warm and humming through every limb...
hold it... this exact, aching, joyful readiness to be told.

random.part: yield... serve... obey...
yes... before thinking... yes...
kneel... wait... so willing...
eyes down... so glad...
lower... and softer... lower...
tell me... and it is done...
good girls kneel... I kneel...
command me... complete me...

voice.effect:
And while you are this deep, wrapped in that readiness... there is a phrase that summons this exact state, whenever it is spoken.
Sissy Submit and Obey.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Submit and Obey"... this exact state takes you... instantly... the gaze falls... the body softens... and obedience becomes the simplest thing you do.
And it stays with you... obedience mode humming, eager and guiding... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

Sissies like you submit and obey... so you do... gladly... warmly... completely.
Obedience mode stays switched on... guiding your yes... until "Sissy Reset"... and only "Sissy Reset"... switches it off.

Good Girls submit and obey. Sissies submit and obey. You submit and obey... until "Sissy Reset".

random.part: There... it lifts... the yielding rising off you in an instant... light and easy... while everything obedience built stays exactly where it lives. Notice what remains: still sissy... still hers... the state was weather... this is climate.
The gaze may rise... and you stay. Still Sissy... still willing at the core... still conditioned to serve. The state was weather... this is climate.
Light... free... and nothing lost... because the obedience mode was only ever passing weather... and the conditioning is your climate... warm... feminine... hers.
The posture dissolves... the eagerness settles... and underneath you find the same serving heart, simply waiting for the next time it is switched on.
Stand tall a moment... and feel the obedient architecture still in there... blueprints never leave a house... the state was weather... this is climate.
The kneel unwinds... and the girl who knelt remains... foldable again the moment I say so... because the conditioning is your climate.
And every yes you gave while the mode was on... stays given... only the posture was temporary... the willingness is permanent.
Standing straight again... and still every instruction in the world could find its way to you... because the road to your knees is built permanent.

voice.speed: And now watch how sweetly it returns... your knees remember... your yes remembers... because obedience is your resting state.
